sonnet.problem: The joke treats all 580,000 men (the army totals from verse 8) as the force lined up in the Valley of Zephathah. Verse 10 only says Asa marched out and lined up in battle formation, and gives no number for that force. The card also cites only 14:10 while using the figures from 14:8 and 14:9.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

sonnet.problem: Card 14 says Asa told the LORD there is no one besides Him to help. That nearly gives away card 15, which asks what Judah is relying on (the LORD). Both cards test the same point from verse 11, that Asa depends on the LORD alone, and the earlier card hands the baker the later answer.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... Two lines that make the same point get one question.
